sqlquery.from:
( select id,employeename ,user_timespent full_timespent,daterange,billabletimespent,nonbillabletimespent, case (full_timespent-user_timespent)>0 when true then (full_timespent-user_timespent) else 0 end nonutilized from ( select u.id,max(coalesce(u.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(u.lastname,'')) employeename , coalesce(max(case when dayOff is true or holiday is true then 0 else coalesce(ard.timeSlot,0)-coalesce(ard.leave,0) end),0) full_timespent , max(dj.from_date) daterange , coalesce(sum(case when t.billable then tsh.timeSpent end),0) billabletimespent , coalesce(sum(case t.billable is not true when true then tsh.timeSpent end),0) nonbillabletimespent , sum(tsh.timespent) user_timespent from "$".myuser u left join "$".timesheet tsh on u.id= tsh.employeeID and u.deleted is not true
join datejoin dj on date(tsh.date) =DATE(DJ.from_date) left join "$".attendancerawdata ard on u.id=ard.employeeId and ard.dateID=dj.id
left join "$".employeetask et on tsh.employeetaskId=et.id left join "$".task t on et.taskid=t.id where u.deleted is not true and t.deleted is not true group by u.id,dj.id ) t )r
